The graph represents the function $y=\frac{a}{x}+k.$ What is the value of $a+k?$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, notice that the horizontal asymptote of the graph is $y=1.5.$ This means that $k=1.5$ and we can re-write our function as

$$
y=\frac{a}{x}+1.5.
$$

Also, we are given that the point $(1,3.5)$ lies on the graph. Substituting its coordinates into the equation above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =\frac{a}{x}+1.5 \\ 3.5 & =\frac{a}{1}+1.5 \\ 2 & =\frac{a}{1} \\ a & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, $a+k=2+1.5=3.5.$
